user.title: Toshiba Legacy TV
user.description: Turn the TV on and enable new device detection in its Apps Control Profile. Enter its IP address or hostname.

pin.title: Toshiba pairing
pin.description: Enter the four-digit PIN displayed on the TV ({host}). It expires quickly. To get a new code, select Restart pairing and submit this form.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair the TV again
reauth_confirm.description: Turn the TV on. Continuing will display a new PIN on its screen.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, without http:// or a path.
error.cannot_connect: The TV did not respond. Check its power, address and network.
error.invalid_pin: Incorrect or expired PIN. Restart pairing to get a new code.
error.pairing_failed: The TV rejected the request. Check new device detection and restart pairing.

abort.unsupported_tv: This TV does not provide the Toshiba IPC v2 PIN pairing API.
abort.wrong_tv: This address belongs to a different television.
